label: Cogito profile with the adopted esse…: Profile o grounds InAct esse retains o and grounds exactly…
term: cogito profile with the adopted esse criterion of concreteness
definition: profile o grounds InAct esse retains o and grounds exactly and sets concrete to HasEsseInRe InAct esse. At the selected world, ExistingInActAt is the explicit intended-interpretation contract: every real existent has esse in re and therefore is concrete. Concreteness adds no further restriction on actually existing ground sources. No converse from esse to indexed existence, grounding-to-causation, causal endpoint presence, or modal rule is supplied.
note: Owner adoption on issue #1113 comment 6684716741 (2026-11-06), not a new floor approval. This profile specializes generic frozen results without changing the arbitrary-predicate countermodels or Challenges. See docs/notes/cogito-esse-1113.md for operation-reading and omission boundaries. This reparameterization alone does not certify the paradigm Anchors required of a full intended interpretation. No model or nonconstant classification is supplied by the definition; those semantic requirements are independent of the conditional theorems.
